evidence.subject: OWN-CASE-05
evidence.claim: A dispatched target produces a captured I64 Program and then has its `test.emit` grant revoked: the root fails before returning with no stack (no saved-owner token), the request trace `[dispatch allowed, effect denied]`, the poisoned guest instance (`terminated-after-guest-failure`) and a per-root frame-pin ledger of entered 2 / released 2 / active 0. The in-process ledger half releases the map pin and both frame pins exactly once and refuses a normal finish while frames are entered. OWNER DECISION 2026-11-20 (decision 6) selects the poison branch: the exposed count is the host ledger of frame entries and exits and the backend's own pin counter is not exposed.
assumptions: Finite behavioral evidence for this run on the binary built from the recorded clean commit; it does not prove lifetime, reclamation, lowering or compiler correctness.
The exposed per-root frame-pin count is the host ledger of frame entries and exits; the backend frame-pin counter itself is not exposed.
`test.abort` is not installable in this profile; its internal-diagnostic refusal is recorded as a frontend-defect witness and is not this case's success condition.
